scene.title: Blood Flow Through the Heart
scene.summary: Deoxygenated blood travels from the body to the right side of the heart, to the lungs, back to the left side, and out to the body.

beats.title: Heart chambers
beats.narration: The heart consists of four chambers that move blood in a loop.

beats.title: Pulmonary circulation
beats.narration: Deoxygenated blood returns from the body to the right atrium, passes to the right ventricle, and is pumped to the lungs.

check.question: After the blood reaches the lungs, where does it go next?
check.explain: Oxygen‑rich blood leaves the lungs and enters the left atrium.

beats.title: Systemic circulation
beats.narration: Oxygenated blood leaves the lungs, enters the left atrium, moves to the left ventricle, and is pumped out to the body.

beats.title: Recap
beats.narration: The heart circulates blood in two loops: pulmonary (right side) and systemic (left side).
